input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns binding clause. Positively, it contains no prohibition on Company assignment and there is no change-of-control trigger anywhere in the Agreement (termination is limited to the 70-day right in Section 2/p0011 and the 90-day rolling notice right in p0024), so nothing lets HDI exit or re-price on our change of control — no walk-away exposure. However, the clause is silent on consent in both directions, which leaves HDI free to assign this hosting/site-development engagement — including our confidential customer data obligations — to anyone, including a competitor. That fails the fallback's material requirement that consent be required (and not unreasonably withheld) for assignments outside a successor transfer. Redline adds the preferred affiliate/successor carve-out for the Company and a reasonable-consent gate plus no-competitor limit on HDI, leaving the existing binding language intact.

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
ops.newText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement. The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We confirmed our right to assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without consent and added a consent gate (not unreasonably withheld) on HDI's assignment, with no assignment to our competitors. HDI hosts our site and holds our customer data, so we need to know who stands behind that obligation.
proposal.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and consent requirement on HDI assignment in Section 10.3.
